correctness.rationale: Rank-two bases are unordered pairs in {p nonclique elements}∪{q singleton classes}, excluding two from the p-parallel class, so E=pq+binom(q,2). An exchange adjacency swaps exactly one element, hence the polytope 1-skeleton is the line graph of H=K_q join p isolated vertices. Let B be the unsigned vertex-edge incidence matrix of H; for e=xy, line-graph Laplacian is L_{L(H)}=diag(d_H(x)+d_H(y))−B^TB. Splitting the edge module into row/column contrasts in the p×q cross incidence block, clique-edge circulation and orthogonal coupled contrasts yields spectral blocks: (p+2q−1)^((p−1)(q−1)), (p+q−1)^(p−1), (2p+2q−2)^(q(q−3)/2), two-dimensional W(t)^(q−1) where W(t)=t²−(2p+3q−1)t+q(3p+2q−1), and central t(t−(2p+q−1)). Dimensions sum E and all factors positive except the unique t=0. Kirchhoff product of nonzero eigenvalues divided by E gives the asserted exact spanning-tree count. Among positive factors the gap is min(S,λ−) where S=p+q−1 and λ−=(2p+3q−1−sqrt((q−1)²+4p(p−1)))/2; W(S)=q−p(p−1), producing switch of Fiedler multiplicity q−1 to p−1 across q=p(p−1) (tie p+q−2, attainable p≥3). Independent exact SymPy Laplacian matrices rebuilt from basis-exchange adjacency for (p,q)=(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4),(4,3); their full characteristic polynomials equal every predicted factor and cofactors agree with Kirchhoff. This is finite corroboration; invariant-subspace calculation and dimension exhaustion constitute the parameter-uniform proof.
